Candidate 0.3.0-rc.1 artifacts are prepared for owner-controlled publication. No public GitHub repository or published release has been configured in this website.

Downloads are unavailable until the maintainer publishes and configures an official release. Do not trust packages from an unverified source.
macOS

Apple Silicon

Bundled runtime and offline installer tested on Apple Silicon. Python 3.12+ is required; no Rust compiler is needed for the package.

Unsigned / not notarized unless a release explicitly states otherwise.
LINUX

Linux

ARM64 package and installer tested in Debian 12 (glibc 2.36). Linux x86_64 builds remain a CI verification step.

See the release-specific build and test matrix.
WINDOWS 10 / 11

Use WSL2

Use the Linux source route inside WSL2 with a matching architecture. WSL2 itself and native Windows remain unverified; native file-isolation tools are disabled.

Do not interpret source portability as verified native protection.

Verify before you install.

Download an artifact and its checksum manifest from the same official release. Inspect the release identity and any available provenance attestations. A checksum detects file changes; it does not establish publisher identity.

# macOS — verify the downloaded checksum file
shasum -a 256 -c sentinel-ai-0.3.0-rc.1-darwin-arm64.tar.gz.sha256

# Linux / WSL2 — from the release download directory
sha256sum -c sentinel-ai-0.3.0-rc.1-linux-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256

Never disable Gatekeeper, Defender, your firewall or system integrity controls. Never pipe an unverified download into a shell.
